t.zh: 只会读文件的板，在这里卡住：模型不知道该读哪个，就要一份目录，可没有元件回应它。新元件<part-ref to="part:list"></part-ref>在模型要目录时，给出仓库的文件和每个文件里的函数。
t.en: A board that can only read gets stuck here: not knowing what to read, the model asks for the file list, and nothing answers. The new part <part-ref to="part:list"></part-ref> gives the repository’s files and the functions in each when the model asks for it.

after.zh: 模型先看目录，再读文件，再改：它用的工具越多，你要事先知道的越少。每个工具的结果都要接回去，它才看得到。
after.en: The model looked at the list, read the file, then changed it: the more tools it has, the less you need to know beforehand. Every tool’s result has to be fed back for it to see.

brief.zh: 这些 issue 只写了函数名。让模型自己找到它在哪个文件里。
brief.en: These issues name only the function. Let the model find which file it is in.
